independent_visual_review.result: A more complete candidate than frozen R2; suitable for user comparison, not a claim of exact historical restoration.
improvements: Four corner medallions independently readable again
Center floral density and value separation improved over R2
Broad reserve branches and lower-contrast fine botanical network form distinct levels
No observed second-perspective distortion or registration drift
residuals: Gold scrollwork and outlines remain sharper and more regular than original
Textile relief remains subtler than original in the red ground and ivory center
The floral composition is newly reconstructed and is not the same historical pattern
